versions.subject: 16 rules from DH APT29 day 1 - contributing soon
versions.detection:
selection1:
    uri:
     - '*.7z'
     - '*.zip'
     - '*.rar'
selection2:
    mime_types: '*compressed'
selection3:
    filetype: '*compressed'
selection4:
    http.bodyMagic: '*compressed'
selection5:
    id_resp_h: 
    - 192.168.0.0/16
    - 172.16.0.0/12
    - 10.0.0.0/8
condition: selection1 and selection2 or selection3 or selection4 and not selection5
versions.spl: (uri IN ("*.7z", "*.zip", "*.rar") mime_types="*compressed") OR filetype="*compressed" OR (http.bodyMagic="*compressed" NOT (id_resp_h IN ("192.168.0.0/16", "172.16.0.0/12", "10.0.0.0/8")))
